findings.finding: Peer read-through: Intesa Sanpaolo's Q3 2026 net profit of ~EUR 2.65bn beat the 2.45-2.49bn expected by Barclays/Equita and NII rose 1.1% q/q, but revenues of EUR 6.92bn missed ~7.0-7.1bn, and Intesa raised FY26 to 'ben oltre 10 miliardi'. The Italian rate and fee environment held up in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: UniCredit's Q3 2025 beat was followed by -2.3% on the day; the Q1 2026 beat-and-raise by +5.9%
findings.original_quote: la banca ha alzato la previsione di utile netto 2026 a ben oltre 10 miliardi (as summarised in search; Intesa highlight page: 'Terzo trimestre e nove mesi record: guidance migliorata a ben oltre €10mld')
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Intesa rose only 0.57% on 3 Nov and the whole sector rallied 4-5% on 4 Nov, which UniCredit joined (+5.45%). Only the Italian half of UniCredit's book transmits; Germany, CEE and Russia do not.

findings.finding: A third 2026 net-profit upgrade is plausible: the guide is >EUR 11.5bn ex integration costs, H1 was ~6.37bn and Q3 consensus is 2.78bn. BofA (EUR 113 target) expects ~3.0bn in Q3 and an upgrade to ~12bn, and UniCredit raised the guide at both Q1 and Q2 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (5 May) raise: +5.9%. Q2 2026 (23 Jul) beat and raise to >11bn: -4.8%. Both directions are on record, and the last raise was sold.
findings.original_quote: Bank of America ... utile netto del terzo trimestre intorno ai 3 miliardi ... potrebbe portare UniCredit ad alzare la guidance 2026 a circa 12 miliardi (paraphrase of article; headline: 'Analisti annusano rialzo guidance')
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly. The upgrade is openly discussed in the Italian press, and the stock fell 11.5% in October on the bank tax and Commerzbank uncertainty, so a raise is not in the multiple (~10x the 2026 guide). Akros sits below consensus, so the upgrade is not unanimous.

findings.finding: Commerzbank's Q3 2026 net profit of EUR 859m came in just under the EUR 864m consensus, with the 2026 target confirmed and the NII guide cut to ~8.5bn from 8.6bn on deposit competition. UniCredit equity-accounts Commerzbank, and the Q3 release was postponed to take in these figures, so the contribution is in line and the German deposit-margin signal is mildly negative for HVB and the combined case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Commerzbank itself fell 2.8% on its 5 Nov release. No record of UniCredit reacting to its associate line.
findings.original_quote: Commerzbank mette a segno il miglior risultato della sua storia e apre, anche sul piano manageriale, una nuova fase nei rapporti con UniCredit
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Commerzbank's own figures have been out since 5 Nov. What is left is how UniCredit presents the associate line and the German NII trend inside HVB.

findings.finding: The 2027 Italian budget asks banks and insurers for EUR 5.5-6bn through a +3pp IRES surcharge (bank IRES to 30.5%) plus IRAP and Tobin-tax changes. Equita puts the hit to sector 2027 EPS at -4/-4.5% but names UniCredit the least exposed. The release or call may give the first company figure, which could trim the FY27-28 path.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026 budget's 'sconto Meloni' reserve release cost UniCredit ~EUR 310m. No measured results-day reaction to a tax line.
findings.original_quote: A uscirne relativamente meno penalizzata sarebbe UniCredit
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. It fed the 11.5% October fall, and the -1.0% FTSE MIB day on 30 Oct was led by banks. Only a company number above the sell-side estimate would be new, and that is macro-to-company transmission the company has not yet confirmed.

findings.finding: The FY26 interim cash dividend of ~EUR 2.8bn (~EUR 1.86/share, 50% of the FY26 cash dividend) will be finalised by the 8 Nov board. It was announced with Q2 in July and there is no 2026 buyback, because the 2025 EUR 4.75bn buyback was cancelled to fund Commerzbank.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction: the interim has been pre-announced every year
findings.original_quote: acconto ... circa 2,8 miliardi, pari a circa il 50% del dividendo cash complessivo dell'esercizio 2026 (paraphrased by article summary)
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the amount and dates have been public since 23 July. It is filed at 0 because it is a sourced fact bearing on the print.

baseline_tension: The lean (-0.017) and the 20-day run-up (+0.33) are flat, and the 5-day +4.56% is a sector rally. The mild positive lean from the guidance and Intesa findings neither agrees nor disagrees with a meaningful priced lean, and the 11.5% October drawdown leaves room for a raise.

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide': a third guidance change is plausible, so abs_move_pct went from 4.0 to 4.5. Kept well below the 9% European median because this is a EUR 110bn bank whose observed results-day moves run 2-6%
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' (the last beat and raise was sold, -4.8% on 23 Jul): the guidance finding went from +0.5 to +0.4 and p_up from 53 to 52
'A narrow proxy loses / macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis': the Intesa read-through went from +0.3 to +0.2 and the bank-tax finding from -0.3 to -0.2
'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': the interim dividend stays at 0.0
'In a live bid, results are noise': the Commerzbank update on the call may outweigh the quarter. Its sign is unknown, so it moved p_up toward 50 and created no finding
